tasks.task: Add async streamCustomerBatches(orders, ownerId, options, emit) in src/reports/batches.ts. Options: size integer 1..1000, optional status paid/pending and afterId cursor. Select owner-visible orders then status, preserve input order, reject duplicate IDs in that selection, and require any afterId to exist there. Emit batches of at most size records as {csv,nextCursor}; each CSV has the existing header and quoting/precision/validation, nextCursor is the last emitted id only when another batch remains. An empty result emits one header-only batch with null cursor. Await each callback and propagate sink errors. Reject bad owner/options/cursor before delivery, preserve original APIs and inputs, and keep shared export rules in one implementation.

tasks.task: Add async streamAuditCsv(orders, authorization, emit) in src/reports/audit.ts. authorization.auditor must be strictly true before any emission. Optional owners and statuses arrays restrict selection; empty arrays select none, absent arrays allow all. Preserve input order and emit ownerId,id,customer,total,status as header then complete CSV records, with ownerId and customer quoted, embedded quotes/newlines preserved, and finite nonnegative totals at two decimals. Await each callback, propagate sink errors, do not mutate orders or authorization, and keep the customer exporter owner isolation unchanged. Audit authorization is independent; reuse shared serialization/validation responsibilities rather than duplicating them.
